preconditions: A cross-section contract contains geological interpretation polygons.
Any polygon below the calculated model limit is explicitly classified as SyntheticBasalContinuation.
decisionLogic: Compute the authoritative unit-area balance only inside the calculated geological model interval.

Treat the classification label as an untrusted claim; exclude only the single canonical continuation polygon after its identity, unit binding, basis, category and full vertex sequence match the model lower boundary and drawing-frame bottom.
Compute and retain a second drawing-frame diagnostic that includes the continuation.
Never add or split lithologies merely to satisfy the portrayal threshold.
outputs: CalculatedGeologicalModelInterval unit-area audit used for pass/fail.
uncertainty: Area thresholds are portfolio portrayal gates, not geological laws or evidence of subsurface truth.
validationMethod: A large declared basal continuation does not alter modeled-interval fractions.
A true modeled unit at the domain limit passes and a value immediately above it fails.
The drawing-frame diagnostic still reports the continuation-inflated fraction.
A forged SyntheticBasalContinuation label on an ordinary polygon remains included and cannot evade the dominance gate.
Any coordinate, unit binding, basis, category or canonical-ID mutation fails closed before area exclusion.
reopenCondition: Reopen if the basal continuation acquires geological evidence or if area thresholds become evidence-authorized geological constraints.
